claim: observed CPU sustained caller workload; no comparison performance or nonregression gate
queue_overflow: drop newest before engine admission; preserve older FIFO inputs
caller_freshness: drop future and source age>60ms before Submit; ALL preserves accepted order and state
deadline_rule: source planned release +20ms; Submit ALL/LATEST soft scheduling target, never an Execute hard deadline
stateless_latest_rule: caller coalesces already queued fresh observations to newest source/index; separate contexts and complete fresh input values
stop_rule: after exactly150 planned releases, drain pending observations; external cancellation stops producer, cancels accepted request and drops pending; no stateful context resumed after failed/cancelled work
latency_interval: actual caller queue enqueue -> first caller observation of terminal SUCCEEDED; includes caller queue and Submit/poll transport, excludes output CopyTensors/reference assertions
completion_precision: terminal status observed by polling; per-request last-nonterminal to terminal brackets recorded; not a native kernel/device timestamp
percentiles: NumPy linear quantile over successful accepted requests; p50/p95/p99 observations without acceptance threshold or CI
memory_scope: /proc/self/status VmRSS sampled whole-process; VmHWM OS process-lifetime high-water (includes imports/load/compile); engine inventory is known scoped capacities, never added to RSS, no whole-interval exact peak or nonregression claim; per-sample phase identifies paced vs setup/teardown observations; sampling interval can overshoot
validation_rule: prepared inputs fixed before measurement; output owned-buffer/copy receipts checked after completion; NumPy allclose atol=rtol=1e-5 and index/time/position exact validated after pacing; first owned output retained until context release
backlog_definition: caller queued observations + one currently processing observation; maximum4; native in-flight maximum1
cancel_rule: cancel accepted pending work only on external stop or native settlement timeout; no cancellation is injected into nominal measurement; final normally completed rows remain completed
